jobs.title: PT Tutor at CSUN 10335 - Physical Therapy
jobs.description: Employer: CSUN 10335 - Physical Therapy Expires: 10/22/2026 ONLY STUDENTS ENROLLED IN CSUN'S GRADUATE DEGREE DPT CAN APPLY! DUTIES:PT Tutors provide academic support to students enrolled in physical therapy courses through individual and small-group tutoring sessions. The tutor assists students in understanding foundational and advanced physical therapy concepts, including anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, and clinical reasoning, while reinforcing classroom and laboratory instruction. Responsibilities include helping students develop effective study habits, time-management skills, and exam-preparation strategies, as well as facilitating review sessions and practice activities to enhance learning. The tutor encourages critical thinking and problem-solving, guides students in the use of academic resources and evidence-based learning tools, and supports the development of clinical documentation and case analysis skills. Additionally, the tutor maintains professionalism and confidentiality in all interactions, communicates with faculty and academic support personnel as needed, and serves as a peer mentor who promotes student confidence, engagement, and academic success within the physical therapy program. QUALIFICATIONS:PT Tutors must be enrolled in the DPT program and in good academic standing. They must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling them to explain complex concepts in a clear, patient, and supportive manner. PURPOSE:PT Tutors provide tutoring services to assist students in understanding foundational and advanced physical therapy concepts. HOURS: 2-20 per week, tba Length of FWS Appointment: Fall through May 15. Any employment beyond May 15 is outside of the FWS program. May be renewed annually based on FWS eligibility. WAGE: $20.00 CLASSIFICATION: Instructional Student Assistant (ISA) DEPARTMENT ID#: 10335
